National Cadet Corps
NCC Camp Details
The National Cadet Corps (NCC) plays a pivotal role in shaping the character, discipline, and leadership qualities of youth. During the academic year 2024–25, the cadets of our institution actively participated in various NCC camps conducted under the able guidance and leadership of
Associate NCC Officer Lt. Dr. K. Vijay Kumar
.
His unwavering dedication, disciplined mentorship, and motivational leadership have been instrumental in encouraging cadets to take part in these enriching experiences.
The camps attended during this academic year not only focused on physical endurance and drill practices but also instilled in cadets a deep sense of patriotism, responsibility, and team spirit.
Through exposure to training, cultural programs, community service, and inter-unit competitions, the cadets developed a well-rounded perspective of their role as responsible citizens and future leaders.
This document highlights the camps attended, the cadets' achievements, and the values inculcated through their active participation in the NCC journey of 2024–25.
Associate NCC Officer
Lt. Dr. K. Vijay Kumar
NCC ANO Officer
